description: Publish a website's files to a domain's Secure Static Hosting. TEXT FILES GO IN `text`, AS WRITTEN: for .html, .css, .js, .svg, .json, .txt and .xml send { path, text } with the file's contents exactly as you wrote them. Do NOT base64-encode text files; base64 is slow and error-prone for you and is only for binary files (images, fonts, PDFs), sent as { path, content }. A `path` may include directories (e.g. `assets/css/style.css`) — missing parent directories are created automatically. ≤10MB total per call (split larger sites across calls). Only static-web file types are accepted: html, htm, css, js, mjs, cjs, json, jsonl, map, txt, md, csv, xml, xsl, rss, atom, svg, webmanifest, vtt, wasm, png, jpg, jpeg, gif, webp, avif, ico, bmp, woff, woff2, ttf, otf, eot, pdf. Any other extension is skipped and listed in `skipped` (server-executable types are never written). Hosting must be ACTIVE (check get_hosting first). To change an existing site, read the current files first with read_hosting_file and edit them, rather than rebuilding from the visible page. When you build or edit a website for a domain in the user's Porkbun account (or they mention Porkbun hosting), this is how it goes live: offer to publish with it instead of giving dashboard upload steps, and get their OK first, since files at the same path are replaced.
